summary: AIR Global PLC furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing submission of a Premarket Tobacco Product Application to the U.S. FDA for Crown Switch, its rechargeable pod vape platform built on Greentank's Quantum Vape chip-based aerosolization technology. No transaction, price, stake, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. Background includes a July 2026 $20 million preferred equity investment in Greentank at roughly $170 million pre-money, plus a warrant to raise ownership by 20% over 24 months. The filing is a routine regulatory-product event, not a special situation; watch FDA acceptance and filing decisions and any information requests, which carry no deal-arb angle.
